queue.name: STUCKIE DOG
queue.descr: In 1980, Georgia loggers discovered a mummified hunting dog, nicknamed "Stuckie," trapped 28 feet inside a hollow chestnut oak tree. The dog, believed to have died around 1960 after chasing prey up the tree, was preserved by natural tannins and a "chimney effect" that dried the body, preventing decay. It remains on display at Southern Forest World in Waycross, Georgia.
